name: app-shell
title: App Shell (template)
description: Template: AppShell, the frame of an application. It places the TopBar, NavSidebar and AppContent patterns on the Theme's canvas (full-height sidebar or full-width top bar, solid or transparent pieces, a brand slot, flat or card content, an optional aside column right of the page), with a skip link; below 64rem the sidebar is the icon rail, below 80rem the aside goes under the page.
